C0002.title: Login Replay Attack Example: Eavesdropper Impersonates User Without Decryption
C0002.summary: Amazon Web Services material explains that in a replay attack, an attacker can capture a password, password hash, session ID, or HTTP authentication request through eavesdropping or a man-in-the-middle position and resend it later. The server may treat the replayed request as legitimate, enabling authentication or authorization bypass, unauthorized access, data exposure, or repeated transactions.

references.title: What Is a Replay Attack? - Amazon Web Services
